hero.title: Build the software layer that keeps the strategy real.
hero.summary: LeCrown turns fragmented operations, product ideas, and integration needs into platforms, portals, and internal tools that teams can actually run on.

visual.title: From concept deck to working system.

systems.title: Internal platforms
systems.text: Custom dashboards, review tools, and team operating systems designed around the actual workflow.

systems.title: Client-facing portals
systems.text: Build portals and web applications that package data, progress, and services into a usable front end.

systems.title: API and integration layers
systems.text: Connect third-party systems, automate data movement, and create cleaner interfaces across business tools.

systems.title: Incubated products
systems.text: Move a new idea from concept to working MVP with both technical and go-to-market support.

deliveryModes.title: Rapid pilot
deliveryModes.text: Fast first version for proving demand, showing buyers, or validating a workflow.

deliveryModes.title: Operational build
deliveryModes.text: A more durable system for internal use, client delivery, or repeated production workflows.

deliveryModes.title: Strategic technical leadership
deliveryModes.text: Architecture, vendor coordination, technical planning, and founder-level product guidance.

process.title: Shape the system
process.text: Translate the business problem into user roles, core workflows, data structures, and delivery priorities.

process.title: Build the usable layer
process.text: Create the application surfaces, integrations, and operator experiences that people will actually rely on.

process.title: Prepare for launch
process.text: Wrap the product in the technical, visual, and messaging assets needed to deploy or sell it.

proof.label: Incubator mode
proof.text: Useful when a new initiative needs velocity, not just code output.

proof.label: Operator mode
proof.text: Useful when a team needs a system to replace spreadsheets, inboxes, or repetitive review steps.

proof.label: Capture mode
proof.text: Useful when public-sector or prime opportunities need a clear technical plan behind the pitch.
